senses.gloss:
ind.
A preposition and particle corresponding to even, though, yet, assuredly, &c. and implying
1 Interrogation.
2 Earnest interrogation or enquiry.
3 Doubt.
4 Possibility.
5 Reproof; and,
6 Conjunction.
7 It is often an expletive.
E.
अ neg. and पि to go, with क्विप् aff.

f. (-पी)
The twentieth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Praised.
E.
अपि before, गीर्ण part. past., irregularly formed from गॄ to sound.

ind.
Moreover, also.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Clear, free from sediment or soil.
E.
अ neg. पिच्छल muddy.

ind.
If, if indeed, yet, but yet.
E.
अपि, and तु but, and, &c.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
See the next.
E.
अ neg. पितृ a father, कव् added.

mfn. (-त्र्यः-त्र्या-त्र्यं)
Uninherited, acquired, not ancestral or paternal.
E.
अ neg. पितृ a father, क्यप् aff.

n. (-नं)
Covering, concealment, disappearance.
E.
अपि before धा to have or hold, and ल्युट् aff. See पिधान.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Clothed, accoutred.
E.
अपि, and नद्ध part. past. of नह to bind.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Upright, honest.
E.
अ neg. पिशुन dishonest.

n. (-नं)
Gentleness, kindness, giving pain to nothing.
E.
अ neg. पीडन paining.

n. (-नं)
1 Squeezing, compressing, tying or drawing tightly.
2 Embracing, clasping.
3 Giving pain, hurting.
E.
आङ् before पीड to pain, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-सः)
Dryness of the nose, want of the pituitary secretion and loss of smell, cold.
E.
अ neg. पीनस the mucus of the nose.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Very handsome.

m. (-त्तः)
Fine.
E.
अप water, पित्त bile; see अपाम्पित्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Drank up.
2 Very yellow.
n. (-तं)
A pyritic mineral.
E.
आङ् before पीत drank or yellow.

m. (-डः)
1 Squeezing, compressing.
2 Giving pain, hurting.
3 A chaplet tied on the crown of the head.
E.
आङ् before पीड to pain, अच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Squeezed, compressed.
3 Bound tightly.
3 Embraced.
4 Hurt.
E.
आङ् before पीडित pressed.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Stout, fat.
m. (-नः)
A well.
n. (-नं)
An udder.
E.
आङ् and पीन fat, large.
